client.topic: AI news today (Oct 29): Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows; Anthropic launches tools showing companies what their AI spending buys; Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon; OpenAI says its Dots assistant will roll out more widely in Europe soon
client.hook: Four AI updates that matter for your business today
client.key_points:
Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows: Google is expanding ads in AI Search worldwide, announced with earnings showing revenue up 25% to $127.6 billion. If you run search ads, watch how this changes where they appear.
Anthropic launches tools showing companies what their AI spending buys: Anthropic now shows companies how users spend money on its models, ahead of a planned IPO. If your team pays for AI tools, usage reports help you see what is worth the cost.
Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon: Gemini 4 Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points, with gains in coding and agent tasks. Ars Technica calls it a slightly better Argon, so no need to rush.
OpenAI says its Dots assistant will roll out more widely in Europe soon: At DevDay Exchange in Berlin, OpenAI said its AI assistant Dots should roll out more widely in Europe in a few weeks. European small businesses may soon get another assistant option.
